description: This file defines the EventScheduler class, a component for scheduling and managing timestamped events, particularly for MIDI event handling in an Android environment. It includes nested classes for event queue management and a base class for schedulable events, with methods for adding, removing, and retrieving events, as well as pooling support.

classes.name: EventScheduler
classes.description: Manages timestamped schedulable events in a thread-safe manner with support for event pooling.

classes.name: EventScheduler.SchedulableEvent
classes.description: Base class representing an event with a timestamp that can be scheduled.

classes.name: EventScheduler.FastEventQueue
classes.description: A thread-safe queue for managing events with rapid add and remove operations, used internally within EventScheduler.

methods.name: EventScheduler()
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the event buffer.

methods.name: removeEventfromPool()
methods.description: Retrieves an event from the pool if available.

methods.name: addEventToPool(SchedulableEvent event)
methods.description: Returns an event to the pool for reuse.

methods.name: add(SchedulableEvent event)
methods.description: Adds an event to the scheduler at its timestamp.

methods.name: getNextEvent(long time)
methods.description: Retrieves the next scheduled event that is due at or before the specified time.

methods.name: waitNextEvent()
methods.description: Blocks until the next scheduled event is ready, throwing InterruptedException if interrupted.
